items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: they left the fraternity house on State Street near Claiborne

ctx.x: I've been asking about Fisher's band.

Because they overlap. Fisher was in Shilling's band and then they'd want to get another pickup band, they'd call it Fisher's band. But I think of the three that I liked Shilling's group the best because they featured, when they'd go into that prize fight, they had all brass except your clarinet. It was, I mean, right on down the line, carnet, trombone, clarinet, tuba, French horn, and never a string bass and they had drums. That was it. And boy, they were hell-bent for election. I have one memory, Bill, which I…
Yeah, it was pretty well mixed up to different personnel.
